notes.title: The Otterman Empire: Creative mode update
notes.content:
Welcome to The Otterman Empire: Creative mode update! 

We are excited to announce that our action-packed multiplayer party game, The Otterman Empire, which launched on July 2nd 2020 on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Xbox has now got it's own creative mode! 


[previewyoutube=_0eIxNDcM7U;full][/previewyoutube]


Create your own custom arenas for you and your friends! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/c9c02acb05be3a174e5fc755e00f1e8e561dc3c5.png[/img]

Battle it out across otterspace, now with your own custom levels and game modes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/6d4d8a27b6ab8825f76a83ae57a603b07f1202fa.png[/img]

Welcome the Spy to the arena! 

£12.99 for a singleplayer campaign, local and online multiplayer and creative mode all in one!

notes.title: THE OTTERMAN EMPIRE: ONLINE UPDATE .... ONE YEAR ON
notes.content:
[b]PLAY WITH UP TO 16 OTTERS ONLINE [/b]

Yes we listened, launching a local only game during a pandemic was not the best circumstances! But after a year of development, we are excited to get everyone playing online! 

Host your own games, open it up or keep it between your friends, customise your characters and customise your match then take to the skies! 

There will be a bug or two, so please bare with us as we work to iron out the kinks! 

[previewyoutube=MxQFwhZdC-s;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]WELCOMING TO THE ARENA, ROBOTTER![/b]

He is fast, he is nimble and he's made of metal (We think) 

Armed with the baddest laser beam in otter space, Robotter blasts his way onto the scene with a whole host of new skins! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/a8da5c6a75cf2c6852048fb671841593a52a36a7.png[/img]

[b]A WORD FROM OUR TEAM[/b]

Thank you for your on-going support. We know it has been a tough year for everyone and we have definitely felt it! 

Last year, we couldn't have asked for a better response but we knew we had more to give! We have been working incredibly hard to get online up and running, not to mention a creative mode and new characters! So we hope you enjoy a taste of what's to come in 2021 from The Otterman Empire.

See you in otterspace,

Kieran and the Tri-Heart Interactive team.

 x 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/21c6cd9d2854bc63bb6e7e1bf575f0337a8fcd2b.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update 28/08/2020 - What have we been up to?
notes.content:
[h1]What have we been up to?[/h1]

It's been over a month since we launched The Otterman Empire and we have been listening to all your feedback, reviews, streams, Tweets and more and have been hard at work from our COVID bunkers working as a team on new content and updates that is coming for the game.

As you may have been seeing from our social media, Discrord and other social channels that we have been working on an update for all three platforms improving and adding features highlighted by the community.

We've been listening to everything you have to say and whilst we're keeping it mostly hush hush here are some of the things you can expect:

. Improved graphic sliders

. Improvement to our Nintendo Switch visuals 

. Adding the sprint function to the tutorial section of the game

There's ton more than just that being added to our multi platform update and we will put out an official breakdown of everything in the update once we are ready to go live with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/ad47201e39d59da106e51bdbb471df32da608250.png[/img]

[h2]But WAIT! There's more....[/h2]

That's not all we've been up to however we have more content in development that we can't wait to show you, we have new characters and maps on the way as well as a load of brand new single player and local multiplayer content.

Without spoiling too much we're working on a brand new set of trials and gameplay content that we've already made some significant progress on that will make both playing solo and with your friends a real game changer, and we can't wait to show you what's in store for The Otterman Empire and the future of Otter Space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/258a6a3bcbc7b840bc3ce0b82cc7f48ccd422ae1.png[/img]

[h3]Follow our journey:[/h3]

We want to hear what you have to say so come join our Discord and follow our social media below and if you haven't already The Otterman Empire is available right now on Nintendo Switch, Steam and Xbox One.

Twitter - @TriHeartInt

Facebook - Tri-Heart Interactive

Instagram - @triheartinteractive

Discord - https://discord.gg/KCpvNG 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/2340d27d1c3623919b9860a1ab6bb0999cf1e6ef.jpg[/img]


Let us know your thoughts!

We love hearing your thoughts about what you like, dislike and would like to see improved for the game and reviews help small developers like us so much and if you have a moment to let us know your thoughts please consider leaving a review on Steam, Xbox or Switch.

Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016940/The_Otterman_Empire/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/f11744bea4bf12f3d0b238af36ab9d9a71d6343a.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update 13/07/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Development Update 13/07/2020[/h1]

Hey otter gang! Hope everyone had an amazing weekend, TH here bringing you all the latest updates from what we are working on from our bunkers at the moment for The Otterman Empire and what we have planned this week.

Dan the Man (lead programmer):

Dan is working on the AI profiling and pathways of a new enemy type we will be adding into The Otterman Empire, we have been listening to your feedback on wanting to see a better enemy variety within the single-player mode of The Otterman Empire and we have been working on three new enemy types already, we have been doing around the clock playtesting for these enemy types getting their pathfinding and profiling fine-tune for when they can be added to the main game for all you lovely otters to blast with your water weapons.

Additionally, Dan is also working on more localisation stuff for some new words that will be being added into the game which is a long process so he will be tackling that later this week.

Chris the Dis (lead artist):

Chris has been working on the character models for our new AI types that will be being added into The Otterman Empire with our new enemy all I can say is this much it's an enemy type Simran and Chris have wanted to add into the game for a long while and frankly it's so stupid it's amazing (ten points to the otter who gets the reference when they see it)

Additionally, he is also working on some art updates for the Nintendo Switch port of the game to be able to get the game to look more aesthetically pleasing without causing any issues for the Switch version of the game.

Team community (Simran, Caroline, and Dan Sheridan)

Team community have been working on continuing to spread the word across the world mainly to news websites, PR journalists, influencers and working away on appearing on podcasts and other interview platforms throughout the week to spread the word of Otter Space.

[h2]Your Experience[/h2]

If you are enjoying the game and haven't yet left your feedback via a Steam Review, would you consider letting others know about your experience? Reviews are super important for small developers like us, and we truly appreciate your support.

https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/1016940

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/f11744bea4bf12f3d0b238af36ab9d9a71d6343a.png[/img]

notes.title: The Otterman Empire: Steam update 001: Steam functionality update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Otters![/h1]

Thanks for your feedback and support. We're always listening. As always, please feel free to join us on our social channels or Discord if you have any questions about the game!


[h2]ADDED[/h2]

[h3]. New Jetpack Input [/h3]

From players feedback we have added a new input for Jump and Jetpack - this is on the left trigger - we have not removed the old mapping so not to confuse players who are already used to the mapping for Jumping and Jetpacking.


[h3]Improved Keyboard Support[/h3]

Player feedback suggested the need for improved keyboard support. The input icons will now show the appropriate icons when using either keyboard or controller.


[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]

Bug fixed that required you to click on the game window to have input for other controllers to join the game - you can now boot the game up, press the Join button on controllers 2 - 4 and they will join the game


[h2]Controller swap fix[/h2]

Bug where the controllers would swap, if the keyboard was used first


[h2]Keyboard fix[/h2]

Now when keyboard is used then the controller, controller 1 will be for player 1

[h2]
Steam VR fix[/h2]

Steam VR plug-in issue has now been resolved - This will stop The Otterman Empire from launching in Steam VR


[h2]Steam Controller fix[/h2]

Steam controller plug-in has now been enabled allowing for the use of the Steam controller for the game


[h2]Start Menu Bug (Versus) [/h2]

Versus mode: When Paused during a round, selecting "Play" to restart the game didn't unpause the game

[h2]
Controller Disconnect[/h2]

The game freezes when the controller is unplugged, causing the music to continuing playing while there is no input


[h2]Video walkthrough [/h2]

For a full break down of our first Steam patch our creative director, Kieran Rogers will walk you through on our official Steam patch video down below.

[previewyoutube=i9gxDvJFxBs;full][/previewyoutube]



[h2]Your Experience[/h2]

If you are enjoying the game and haven't yet left your feedback via a Steam Review, would you consider letting others know about your experience? Reviews are super important for small developers like us, and we truly appreciate your support.

https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/1016940

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/d16a5bc9fd1ff2c908a58f0c52aae932fb8e1180.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update 18/06/202
notes.content:
Hey everyone Simran here just bringing you all the latest news on what the team are up to from our COVID bunkers as we grow closer to launch.

Team community aka me, Caroline and Dan Sheridan have been working our butts off spreading the word of the Otter to communities, press and influencers and anyone who will hear the word of the Otter and help increase our reach so that more people can enjoy this journey with us.

Chris has been working away on post-release content for TOE and launch key art and additional marketing assets alongside Kieran to get things ready for when July 2nd comes.

Dan our lead programmer has been working on more PC options for The Otterman Empire adding fine things to make the PC experience of the game better things like better graphics sliders and audio sliders just ways to make the Steam experience more better for the community who will be playing the game on the PC platform as well as some additional optimisations to make the game more stable I keep saying that a lot in our updates but to be honest there's always behind the scenes stuff that can always be done, make a load time a millisecond less, lower the amount of processing art assets use up, thinking of new ways to make UI clearer or make some sounds that little bit extra crispy.

Not long until the big day otters get your Switches, Xbox's or Steam account ready to head to Otter Space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/a8659fe12a4996301099c67632b6d5b61266acb8.jpg[/img]
